dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 20, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Tigers' Staff Effort Shines in 4-1 Win Over White Sox**

In a dominating performance, the Detroit Tigers' staff combined to shut down the Chicago White Sox, securing a 4-1 victory. Dillon Dingler led the way offensively with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 2-RBI performance, including a standout 17th homer on a fly ball to center field. Sean Newcomb impressed on the mound with 3.0 IP of scoreless ball, striking out 4 without allowing a walk or hit. Troy Melton earned the win, while Joe Rock took the loss for the White Sox.

**Cincinnati Reds Rout Yankees, 10-2**

The Cincinnati Reds exploded for 10 runs, highlighted by Sal Stewart's 6-RBI effort, in a 10-2 thrashing of the New York Yankees. Will Warren shined on the mound, striking out 8 in 5.2 IP. The Reds' offense was well-balanced, with multiple players contributing to the high-scoring affair. Andrew Abbott earned the win, while the Yankees' Will Warren took the loss.

**Blue Jays Outlast Cubs, 8-6**

In a back-and-forth contest, the Toronto Blue Jays ultimately outlasted the Chicago Cubs, 8-6. Daulton Varsho provided the big blow with a 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. Colin Rea pitched 5.1 scoreless innings for the Blue Jays, while Jeff Hoffman earned the win. Jacob Webb took the loss for the Cubs.

**Padres Edge Rangers, 6-4**

The San Diego Padres edged the Texas Rangers, 6-4, behind a strong outing from Walker Buehler. Buehler struck out 7 in 5.1 IP, allowing just 1 ER. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 5-RBI performance. Adrian Morejon earned the win, while Joe Ross took the loss for the Rangers.

**Nats Rally Past Rays, 4-3**

The Washington Nationals rallied for a 4-3 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, thanks in part to Dylan Crews' 2-hit, 1-home run performance. Brad Lord pitched 3.0 scoreless innings for the Nationals, striking out 5. Mitchell Parker earned the win, while Ian Seymour took the loss for the Rays.

**Marlins Outlast Giants, 6-3**

The Miami Marlins outlasted the San Francisco Giants, 6-3, behind Max Meyer's 5.0 IP of 2-ER ball. Casey Schmitt led the Giants' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. Meyer earned the win, while Trevor McDonald took the loss for the Giants.

**Braves Edge Brewers, 4-3**

The Atlanta Braves edged the Milwaukee Brewers, 4-3, behind Ozzie Albies' 3-hit, 2-home run performance. Chris Sale pitched 5.2 scoreless innings for the Braves, striking out 7. Dylan Lee earned the win, while Aaron Ashby took the loss for the Brewers.

**Guardians Rout Astros, 8-1**

The Cleveland Guardians routed the Houston Astros, 8-1, behind Joey Cantillo's 8.0 IP of 1-ER ball. Cantillo struck out 9 and allowed just 4 H. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with a 4-hit, 2-home run performance. Joey Cantillo earned the win, while Spencer Arrighetti took the loss for the Astros.

**Phillies Pound Mets, 15-3**

The Philadelphia Phillies pounded the New York Mets, 15-3, behind Kyle Schwarber's 4-hit, 3-home run performance. Schwarber drove in 6 runs, including a standout 28th homer on a fly ball to right field. Cristopher Sánchez earned the win, while Freddy Peralta took the loss for the Mets.

**Rockies Edge Pirates, 2-1**

The Colorado Rockies edged the Pittsburgh Pirates, 2-1, behind Paul Skenes' 6.0 IP of 2-ER ball. Skenes struck out 8 and allowed just 4 H. Spencer Horwitz led the Rockies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. Tomoyuki Sugano earned the win, while Paul Skenes took the loss for the Pirates.

**Angels Shut Out Athletics, 7-0**

The Los Angeles Angels shut out the Athletics, 7-0, behind Walbert Ureña's 5.0 IP of scoreless ball. Ureña struck out 6 and allowed just 4 H. Denzer Guzman led the Angels' offense with a 1-hit, 1-home run performance. Walbert Ureña earned the win, while J.T. Ginn took the loss for the Athletics.

**Orioles Edge Dodgers, 2-3**

The Baltimore Orioles edged the Los Angeles Dodgers, 3-2, behind Trevor Rogers' 7.0 IP of scoreless ball. Rogers struck out 6 and allowed just 1 H. Shohei Ohtani led the Dodgers' offense with a 1-hit, 1-home run performance. Trevor Rogers earned the win, while Yoshinobu Yamamoto took the loss for the Dodgers.

**Red Sox Shut Out Mariners, 5-1**

The Boston Red Sox shut out the Seattle Mariners, 5-1, behind Connelly Early's 6.0 IP of 1-ER ball. Early struck out 7 and allowed just 2 H. Wilyer Abreu led the Red Sox' offense with a 1-hit, 1-home run performance. Connelly Early earned the win, while Emerson Hancock took the loss for the Mariners.

**Twins Rout Diamondbacks, 16-8**

The Minnesota Twins routed the Arizona Diamondbacks, 16-8, behind a strong team effort. Byron Buxton led the Twins' offense with a 1-hit, 1-home run performance. Taj Bradley pitched 5.0 IP of 2-ER ball, striking out 4. Taj Bradley earned the win, while Zac Gallen took the loss for the Diamondbacks.
